description: The effective config block that wgft agent run writes to stderr, for fixed inputs. config says how the dotenv file is named: flag means --config PATH, env means WGFT_CONFIG=PATH. dotenv is the file's content, or null for a file that does not exist. env lists variables to set; every other WGFT_* variable, WGFT_CONFIG and GOMEMLIMIT are unset. args are the flags given to agent run, without --config. want is the whole block, header included.

cases.name: defaults
cases.note: Only WGFT_DATA_DIR is set, so that no line depends on the operating system's default.
cases.want:
effective config:
  WGFT_AGENT_ALLOW_TARGETS =                              from default
  WGFT_AGENT_BATCH_MIB   =                              from default
  WGFT_AGENT_NETSTACK    =                              from default
  WGFT_DATA_DIR          = /srv/wgft                    from env
  WGFT_JOIN              =                              from default
  WGFT_MAX_TCP_FLOWS     = 2048                         from default
  WGFT_MAX_UDP_FLOWS     = 8192                         from default
  WGFT_MODE              =                              from default
  WGFT_NAME              =                              from default
  WGFT_WG_INTERFACE      = wgft0                        from default

cases.name: precedence
cases.note: A flag beats the environment, the environment beats the file, the file beats the default.
cases.want:
effective config:
  WGFT_AGENT_ALLOW_TARGETS =                              from default
  WGFT_AGENT_BATCH_MIB   =                              from default
  WGFT_AGENT_NETSTACK    =                              from default
  WGFT_DATA_DIR          = /env/data                    from env
  WGFT_JOIN              = ****                         from file
  WGFT_MAX_TCP_FLOWS     = 2048                         from default
  WGFT_MAX_UDP_FLOWS     = 3000                         from flag
  WGFT_MODE              = userspace                    from env
  WGFT_NAME              = from-file                    from file
  WGFT_WG_INTERFACE      = wgft0                        from default

cases.name: empty environment value wins
cases.note: A variable that is present in the environment with an empty value still takes precedence over the file. An empty secret is shown empty, not as ****.
cases.want:
effective config:
  WGFT_AGENT_ALLOW_TARGETS =                              from default
  WGFT_AGENT_BATCH_MIB   =                              from default

cases.name: foreign and unknown names
cases.note: Names the agent does not read are ignored without a message. Keys are case-sensitive. A UTF-8 byte order mark becomes part of the first key, so that line sets nothing.
cases.want:
effective config:
  WGFT_AGENT_ALLOW_TARGETS =                              from default
  WGFT_AGENT_BATCH_MIB   =                              from default

cases.name: long name and long value
cases.note: A name longer than 22 characters and a value longer than 28 characters are not cut; the value is shown as given, not normalised.
